description: Wolves spawn naturally in the Chrono Dawn Forest, whose ground is Temporal Grass, because Temporal Grass is in minecraft:wolves_spawnable_on. Wolves are generated with the chunks (a chunk gets a creature pack with only about a 10% chance, and the wolf spawn rule needs light level 9 or more on the ground), so the scenario force-loads a 240 block square and counts wolves standing in that biome. Forest is rare with the scenario seed: around the forest nearest to 0 0 (an edge at 704 -16) only about 12% of that square is forest, and no wolf spawned there on 26.3. So the scenario locates from -1120 1184, inside the largest forest within 1536 blocks of 0 0 (about 55% of the square). Spawns made with the chunks depend only on the seed and the chunk, so each Minecraft version gives the same wolves every run, but a version can differ from another one. It does not cover the Dark Forest: its canopy keeps the ground too dark, so no wolf (or Time Keeper) has been seen there even over a 240 block square. The player enters the dimension at 0 0 first, so the Time Keeper Village (placed near wherever a player first enters) stays away from what this scenario looks at.
steps: execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload add 48 0 63 15
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 56 200 8 chronodawn:temporal_grass_block
execute in minecraft:overworld run setblock 56 200 8 minecraft:air
execute in minecraft:overworld run forceload remove 48 0 63 15
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers 0 0 0 1 false ${player}

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn positioned -1120 70 1184 run locate biome chronodawn:chronodawn_forest

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run spreadplayers ${x} ${z} 0 1 false ${player}
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s run forceload add ~-120 ~-120 ~120 ~120

steps.command: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s as @e[type=minecraft:wolf,distance=..170] at @s if biome ~ ~ ~ chronodawn:chronodawn_forest

steps: execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s as @e[type=minecraft:wolf,distance=..170] at @s if biome ~ ~ ~ chronodawn:chronodawn_forest run data merge entity @s {NoAI:1b}

execute in chronodawn:chronodawn as ${player} at @s as @e[type=minecraft:wolf,distance=..170,sort=furthest,limit=1] at @s if biome ~ ~ ~ chronodawn:chronodawn_forest run tp ${player} ~ ~2 ~-3 facing entity @s eyes
execute in chronodawn:chronodawn run time set noon

steps.note: A wolf that spawned with the chunks in the Chrono Dawn Forest, standing still (its AI is switched off) about 3 blocks in front of the camera, which looks straight at it (leaves may cover part of the view). It renders as a normal wolf (on 1.21.1 there are no wolf coat variants yet).
